title: Beta Function
subtitle: Special Functions · Two-argument
summary: Symmetric function of two arguments, related to the Gamma function.
detail:
\[ B(a,b) = \frac{\Gamma(a)\Gamma(b)}{\Gamma(a+b)} = \int_0^1 t^{a-1}(1-t)^{b-1}\,dt \]

Symmetric: \(B(a,b)=B(b,a)\). Used in Bayesian statistics (Beta distribution), combinatorics, and the theory of hypergeometric functions.
